title: Reserved Seats
text:
The details of reserved seats are as under:

Two seats per program are reserved for Afghan Students.

2% seats per program are reserved for Sports.

5% seats per program are reserved for students from Ex FATA

one seat per program is reserved for students of Balochistan, Punjab, Sindh and Gilgit Baltistan.

One seat per program is reserved for Disable student.

2% seats per program are reserved for Physically Handicapped (Blind students).

One seat per program is reserved for AWKUM Employee Children.

One seat per program is reserved for Overseas Pakistan Children.

One Seat per program is reserved for minorities.
